newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity estimates November equity fund flows rose.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity estimates November equity fund flows rose.

text.p: Fidelity Investments estimated that investors poured more than $1 billion of money into its domestic equity funds in November, picking up from only "slightly positive" net sales in October.

"Equity sales have picked up this month relative to last month," spokeswoman Robyn Tice said. "After the slowdown in October, investors are responding to the stock market's recent record highs by adding money to equity mutual funds."
The largest beneficiaries of the net inflows into the mutual funds were Contrafund, Growth And Income, Low-Priced Stock and Dividend Growth, she said.
Net flows into international equity funds were "slightly negative" in November after an estimated outflow of more than $100 million in October, Tice said.

Bond funds turned "slightly positive" in November after losing more than an estimated $100 million in October and money market funds had a net inflow of more than an esimtated $1 billion in November, down from more than an estimated $3 billion in October.
